name: Post Etsy and Shopify products to Pinterest and Instagram with SocialRobot and OpenAI

parameters.content:
## Turn Etsy and Shopify products into Pinterest pins and Instagram posts

For Etsy sellers and Shopify stores: once a day, the workflow takes one product from your shop that it hasn't posted yet, writes a Pinterest title, a pin description and an Instagram caption from the real listing, and posts your **real product photo**. SocialRobot pins it to your Pinterest board with a link to the product, and posts it to Instagram.

**Only Pinterest and Instagram are on by default.** The Instagram carousel, Facebook and Threads nodes are wired in but **disabled by default**; see the sticky note **Optional posts (disabled)**.

### How it works
1. **Daily Schedule Trigger** (10:00) or **Manual Start Trigger** starts a run. **Configure Catalog Settings** holds every setting.
2. **Fetch SocialRobot Accounts** and **Fetch Pinterest Board List** find your Pinterest account and the board you named.
3. **Switch Product Source Route** reads your products from the Etsy shop RSS feed, the Etsy API or Shopify and turns them into one product shape.
4. **Filter Posted Products** drops products already in the Data Table, and **Select Products for Posting** keeps 1 per run.
5. **Generate Pin and Caption** writes the copy from the listing facts only. **Assemble Social Media Post** falls back to template copy if the AI mentions sales, reviews, stock or prices.
6. **Post Pinterest Pin via SocialRobot API** and **Post Instagram Photo** publish. **Log Posted Product** records the product so it isn't posted twice.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Install the SocialRobot community node `@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot` (3.1.2+) and add your SocialRobot API key as the SocialRobot credential (used by **Fetch SocialRobot Accounts** and **Post Instagram Photo**)
- [ ] Connect Pinterest and Instagram in SocialRobot. Pick the Instagram account in **Post Instagram Photo**
- [ ] Add a **Header Auth** credential for the SocialRobot API calls: name `x-api-key`, value your SocialRobot API key. Select it in **Fetch Pinterest Board List** and **Post Pinterest Pin via SocialRobot API** (and **Post Instagram Carousel via SocialRobot API** if you enable it)
- [ ] Create the Data Table `socialrobot_posted_products` as described in the sticky note **Data Table setup**
- [ ] In **Configure Catalog Settings**, set `source` (`etsy_rss`, `etsy_api` or `shopify`), your shop and `pinterest_board_name`
- [ ] Only for `etsy_api`: add a separate **Header Auth** credential with name `x-api-key` and value `keystring:shared_secret` from your Etsy app. Select it in **Retrieve Etsy Shop Details**, **Fetch Active Etsy Listings** and **Fetch Etsy Listing Images**
- [ ] Only for `shopify`: add a Shopify Access Token credential (custom app, `read_products` scope) in **Fetch Shopify Products**, and set `shopify_store_url` and `shopify_currency`
- [ ] Add an OpenAI credential to **OpenAI Luna Chat Model**, or set `use_openai` to false
- [ ] Click *Execute workflow* once, check the pin and the post, then activate

n8n Cloud: works on Cloud and self-hosted. No Execute Command node, no local files, no image generation.

Community node: SocialRobot (`@socialrobot-io/n8n-nodes-socialrobot`) is a community node. It isn't maintained by n8n; install it at your own risk.

### Customization
- `products_per_run`, `post_order` (newest_first or oldest_first) and the time in **Daily Schedule Trigger**.
- `pin_image_count` (1-5), `link_tracking_params`, `include_price` (off by default: pins live for years and prices change).
- `caption_language`, `caption_tone`, `instagram_call_to_action`, `extra_hashtags`, `business_footer`.

### Cost per run
| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| OpenAI `gpt-6-luna` copy, 1 product | about $0.001 |
| Etsy RSS, Etsy API, Shopify | $0 |
| SocialRobot posts | included in your SocialRobot plan |

No images are generated. OpenAI list prices on 24 Oct 2026: $0.10 per 1M input and $0.50 per 1M output tokens (about 3 cents a month at 1 product a day).

## Start and configure

Provides the scheduled and manual entry points, then sets the catalog/source configuration used by the rest of the workflow.

## Select Pinterest destination

Fetches SocialRobot accounts, chooses the Pinterest account, retrieves available boards, and selects the board for publishing pins.

## Route product source

Branches execution to the Etsy RSS, Etsy API, or Shopify product-ingestion path based on the configured catalog source.

## Load Etsy RSS products

Downloads an Etsy shop RSS feed, parses the XML, and normalizes feed items into the shared product structure.

## Load Etsy API products

Finds the Etsy shop by name, retrieves active listings and their photos, then normalizes the API response into product items.

## Load Shopify products

Fetches published products with n8n's Shopify node (Shopify Access Token credential from a custom app with the `read_products` scope) and transforms them into the common product format used by the posting flow. Only active products with a photo are used; links are built from `shopify_store_url`.

## Filter posting candidates

Checks the posted-products table to skip duplicates, then limits the remaining products to the number selected for the current run.

## Generate post copy

Decides whether to use OpenAI, optionally generates structured pin and caption copy with the LLM, and builds final post text for publishing.

## Publish Pinterest Instagram

Creates the Pinterest pin via the SocialRobot API (title, description, alt text and the product link) and posts an Instagram photo with the SocialRobot node. The Instagram carousel request is **disabled by default**; see **Optional posts (disabled)**.

## Facebook and Threads (disabled)

Facebook and Threads photo posts through SocialRobot nodes. Both are **disabled by default**: enable a node and pick an account to cross-post in the same run.

## Check posting results

Summarizes the publish attempts and branches based on whether any platform successfully published the product.

## Log or fail

Records successfully posted products in the data table, or stops the workflow with an error when posting failed.

## Data Table setup
In n8n, open *Data tables* and create `socialrobot_posted_products` (lowercase) with these text columns:
`product_key`, `source`, `title`, `product_url`, `pinterest_post_id`, `instagram_post_id`, `posted_at`.

To post a product again, delete its row.

## Optional posts (disabled)
Connected and **disabled by default**. Enable a node and pick an account; it publishes in the same run.
- **Post Instagram Carousel via SocialRobot API**: up to `instagram_carousel_images` photos (Etsy API or Shopify). The node takes one photo, so this calls the SocialRobot API: set `instagram_account_id_for_carousel` and disable **Post Instagram Photo** so you don't post twice.
- **Post Facebook Photo**: photo post with the product link
- **Post Threads Photo**: photo post with the product link, under 500 characters

## AI label and honest product content
- The photos are your **real product photos** from the listing. Nothing is generated or edited, so the Instagram AI label is off.
- The text is AI-written from your listing. It may only use facts from the title, description, tags and materials.
- No reviews, ratings, stars, testimonials or customer quotes. No sales, discounts, stock or shipping promises. **Assemble Social Media Post** replaces AI copy that mentions any of these (or a price) when your listing doesn't.
- Prices are never written by AI. `include_price` adds the exact shop price with "Price when posted:". It's off by default because pins stay up for years.
- Every pin links to the real product page.
- Posts go out right away, with no review step. Run it manually first, read the copy, and delete any post that doesn't match the listing.

assignments.name: caption_tone
assignments.value: Warm, simple and personal, like a maker talking about their work. Short sentences. No hype or superlatives.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "short_name": "Speckled stoneware mug",
  "pinterest_title": "Speckled stoneware mug, handmade 350 ml coffee mug with brown rim",
  "pinterest_description": "A handmade speckled stoneware mug with a warm brown rim, glazed inside and out. Holds 350 ml, a good size for coffee or tea. Made by hand in a small studio.",
  "instagram_caption": "Fresh out of the kiln: our speckled stoneware mug with a brown rim. 350 ml, glazed inside and out. #handmademug #stoneware #ceramics",
  "facebook_caption": "Our speckled stoneware mug: 350 ml, glazed inside and out, with a warm brown rim.",
  "threads_caption": "New in the shop: a speckled stoneware mug with a brown rim, 350 ml."
}

nodes.name: Post Pinterest Pin via SocialRobot API

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ scheduledFor: { publish: 'NOW' }, post: { accountId: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pinterest_account_id, boardId: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pinterest_board_id, title: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pin_title, description: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pin_description, altText: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.alt_text, link: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pin_link, mediaType: 'IMAGE', medias: { mediaType: 'IMAGE', medias: $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json.pin_image_urls.map(u => ({ mediaUrl: u })) } } }) }}

nodes.name: Post Instagram Carousel via SocialRobot API

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const b = $('Assemble Social Media Post').item.json; const urls = b.instagram_carousel_urls || []; return JSON.stringify({ scheduledFor: { publish: 'NOW' }, post: urls.length >= 2 ? { accountId: $('Configure Catalog Settings').first().json.instagram_account_id_for_carousel, caption: b.instagram_caption, mediaType: 'CAROUSEL', isAiGenerated: false, isStory: false, isReel: false, medias: urls.map(u => ({ mediaType: 'IMAGE', mediaUrl: u })) } : { accountId: $('Configure Catalog Settings').first().json.instagram_account_id_for_carousel, caption: b.instagram_caption, mediaType: 'IMAGE', isAiGenerated: false, mediaUrl: urls[0] || '' } }); })() }}
